scope: Browser-closed synthetic Contact Node host, not whole installed app or real provider.
trailing_partial: included in p95 and whole-run mean
threshold: five-second nominal nonoverlapping CPU window p95 < 1 percent of one logical core
additional_metrics: raw cumulative user/system CPU and actual monotonic elapsed milliseconds
one_second_runs: Preserved separately; never reclassified as five-second passes.
method_reason: The original design does not prescribe a sampling interval. Coarse Windows CPU accounting can make the one-second minimum nonzero sample exceed 1%; raw data and both windows distinguish resolution from actual load. Independent read-only methodology review accepted this explicit protocol change, not retroactive reinterpretation.
